proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen claim incorrectly says that total coverage itself is an exponential times a polynomial. Because the policy reports the full target range outside the count box, total coverage is one minus the exponential--polynomial failure probability. The correction also makes explicit that grid points must be algebraic for algebraic representative and enclosure claims. No statistical parameter class is changed.

proposed.citation: Jacek Bochnak, Michel Coste, and Marie-Francoise Roy. Real Algebraic Geometry. Springer, 1998. DOI 10.1007/978-3-662-03718-8.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Adds the published source used for semialgebraic projection, stratification, paths, and finite-component decomposition.
Adds the overlap and nuisance-box assumptions used directly in the uniform cell-mean bound, compactness argument, and positive-denominator calculation. The claim is unchanged.
Wires the cited semialgebraic theorem into the corrected proof spine while carrying the narrowed claim and preserving its declared free symbols.

open_obligations.what_is_open: A terminating synthesis proof must refine the finite closed cover by profile-validity regions into finitely many rational polyhedral observable cells, including nominal-coverage and target-endpoint contacts, and must construct the mandated early-kill primal and complete integral lower tree.
open_obligations.obstruction: Fixed-design exponential--polynomial separation terminates only for strict rational comparisons. At a zero-margin contact, interval refinement does not determine on which side a profile remains honest or risk-feasible; the profile-validity boundaries can be curved and are not shown to admit a finite rational-polyhedral refinement with one uniformly valid table per cell. The current core also contains no explicit early-kill policy table or exact branch-and-bound witness from which acceptance could be checked.
open_obligations.attempted: Count truncation and outward endpoint rounding give a uniform error ledger; finite action-profile enumeration gives exact finite nuisance witnesses at each fixed design; semialgebraic stratification gives finitely many critical components at algebraic fixed designs; and the global task reduces to a finite closed-cover condition. These routes certify strict-margin regions but do not resolve exact contacts or produce the required globally share-uniform early-kill artifacts.
